title: First Unique Character
statement: A roll call system writes each student's initial into a string as they arrive. Find the position of the first initial that appears exactly once in the whole string. Positions start at 0.
input_format: One line with a string of lowercase English letters.
output_format: Print the index of the first character that occurs exactly once, or -1 if there is none.

examples.explanation: Counts: a=2, b=2, c=1, d=1. The first character with count 1 is c at index 3.

hints: You need to know how many times each letter appears before you can decide.
Make one pass to count every letter, then a second pass to find the first count of one.
There are only 26 letters, so a small array works as well as a map.
